Ecosia operates as a non-profit organization that reinvests profits into environmental initiatives, particularly reforestation. It provides search results primarily from Google while maintaining a commitment to sustainability. The company offers tools like its browser extension, AI chatbot, and a proprietary browser, all designed to reduce carbon footprint and promote eco-friendly digital practices.
